item.title: 13 Nov 2026: Tech Sell-Off Pressures Markets as Nvidia Shifts
item.description:
The S&P 500 slipped 0.36 percent on Friday but secured a 2.59 percent gain for the week, as strength in energy and consumer defensive sectors offset severe technology pressure. Nvidia faced leadership uncertainty while Treasury yields topped 5 percent, driving rotation across major sectors. We examine today's key moves across technology, energy, healthcare, and global trade.
📺 Watch the video version with charts on YouTube: Active Thinker (@activethinker-t5v): https://www.youtube.com/@activethinker-t5v
In this episode: the market overview, the top story in each of the 11 sectors, and the week's key geopolitical developments.
